decisions.reason: With the companion loader line already withdrawn, the underground dump trucks lose fleet synergies and look vulnerable, but existing customers' service and parts needs argue for keeping them one more year.
The construction site dumper fits the firm's construction and transport know-how and shares components with its vehicle range, so it is kept while it builds sales.
Inclined furniture lifts are a niche with steady demand from movers, and its own website page signals a core, actively marketed line.
Building material lifts serve roofers and builders in a stable segment and share design and parts with the furniture lifts, which justifies keeping them.
The truck-mounted version extends the lift family to a premium mobile segment with shared engineering, so it remains in the range.
